provider: Iowa Title Guaranty (ITG) — Residential Premium Rates (state guaranty program, division of the Iowa Finance Authority)

settlementFee.note: Iowa has NO private title insurance market for residential closings -- confirmed via First American's own 'Laws & Customs' reference and Iowa Finance Authority materials: Iowa is the only U.S. state with no title insurers licensed to write policies in-state. ITG is a state-run title guaranty program (not a private underwriter) and prices with a flat statewide rate rather than a tiered private-underwriter schedule.
settlementFee.lenderOnlyCoverage: $0-$750,000 -> $175 flat; over $750,000 -> $175 + $1.00 per $1,000 over $750,000 (purchase and refinance identical)
settlementFee.ownerOnlyCoverage: $0-$750,000 -> $175 flat; over $750,000 -> $175 + $1.00 per $1,000 over $750,000 (purchase only; N/A for refinance -- owner coverage persists through a refinance without a new certificate)
settlementFee.simultaneousCoverage: $0-$750,000 -> $175 flat (based on the certificate with the higher coverage amount); over $750,000 -> $175 + $1.00 per $1,000 over $750,000 (purchase only; N/A refinance)
settlementFee.additionalConcurrentCoverage: $35.00 (junior/HELOC issued with a lender certificate; both purchase and refinance)
settlementFee.endorsements: Most available for no additional premium; endorsements issued apart from the original transaction (e.g. Modification ALTA 11-06): $50.00
